title: CandidateProposal
description: Versioned structured output contract for the AI Candidate Studio's reasoning-model candidate generation (Issue #252, prompt/schema version candidate-studio-proposal-v1). The model returns this object as strict JSON; probe-agent NEVER treats free-form model text as code. `generated_code` must define a single top-level `def candidate(*args, **kwargs)` drop-in replacement for the target symbol; the applied patch is produced DETERMINISTICALLY by splicing that function into the resolved symbol's pinned-snapshot span and diffing (app/candidate_studio.py) — the model never emits a diff directly, and the diff is scope-validated to touch only the target symbol's file. Any missing/invalid field, a missing candidate function, an over-size body, or an out-of-scope/empty diff fails the proposal closed (no heuristic fallback). The reasoning provenance (provider/model/prompt_version/schema_version/decision_method/is_mock/status) is persisted separately in intelligence_runs (Principle 7).

summary.description: One- or two-sentence description of what the candidate changes and why.

assumptions.description: Assumptions the model made about inputs/behavior that a reviewer should confirm.

changed_symbols.description: Symbols the model intends to change. Advisory metadata only; the enforced scope is the single target symbol (the deterministic splice can only ever change that one function's file).

generated_code.description: A single top-level `def candidate(*args, **kwargs)` that is a drop-in replacement for the target function. No imports, file/network/subprocess/env access.

risks.description: Risks or edge cases the reviewer should weigh before adopting the candidate.

suggested_tests.description: Review-only test ideas grounded in the recorded traces; never executed or written to the target repository by generation.
